title: Cheese Ravioli with Sage, Walnut and Brown Butter Pesto
changes_from_base: Browned butter infused with sage is blended with toasted walnuts, parsley and parmesan into a pesto that replaces the plain butter sauce, with shop-bought cheese ravioli in place of homemade.
summary: Cheese ravioli cloaked in a rich pesto of nutty brown butter, sage and toasted walnuts.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
fine sea salt or table salt, for the cooking water

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Melt 85 g butter in the frying pan over medium-high heat, swirling without stopping, for 2-4 min until golden and smelling nutty.

steps.title: Infuse
steps.text: Away from the heat, mix in 20 g sage and let it cool for about 10 min.

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Bring about 4000 ml water to the boil, slip in 2 unpeeled garlic cloves for 1 min, cool them under cold water, then peel and finely chop.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Add 680 g cheese ravioli with 1 tbsp salt, stir often and cook until al dente; reserve 120 ml of the water, then drain and tip them back in.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Pulse the garlic, sage butter, 30 g parsley, 40 g parmesan and 60 g walnuts for 20-30 pulses until finely ground, scraping down the sides.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Finish with ¼ tsp salt and ¼ tsp black pepper.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Turn the ravioli through about 240 ml of the sage-walnut pesto, thinning with cooking water a spoonful at a time, and offer the rest at the table.

tips: Keep the butter moving constantly so it browns evenly instead of scorching.
This pesto has walnuts in it, so flag it for anyone with a nut allergy.
The ravioli may contain egg, so read the label.
storage: Keep leftover pesto chilled under a film of oil for up to 2 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
